newsitem.title: PERU: Peru troops celebrate after storming Lima residence.
newsitem.headline: Peru troops celebrate after storming Lima residence.

text.p: Peruvian troops were seen celebrating on the roof and congratulating each other on Tuesday after they stormed the Japanese ambassador's residence in Lima and freed at least 60 hostages.
The hostages freed after a battle between troops and Marxist rebels who had held 72 people in the building included Peruvian Foreign Minister Francisco Tudela and Japanese ambassador Morihisa Aoki.
